text: This might be a bit silly of me, apologies. I'm looking after my granddaughter, she's 4 months, and her temperature is 38.8. She won't go down to sleep tonight. Every time I put her in the cot she grizzles, but in my arms she's her normal self. I think it might be teeth. She's dribbling buckets, gnawing on anything she can get hold of, and one cheek is bright red. Her mum also left me a note about some red spots on her arms and legs. Those are mosquito bites, she was out in the garden in her pram all afternoon and the little devils got her. Nothing new has come up since, just those few bumps. Is 38.8 too much to put down to teething, or am I fussing over nothing?
